in_marathi.name: Bhart
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhart हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bhart is derived from the Sanskrit word Bhartā, which means 'the sustainer or supporter of the world'. In Hindu mythology, Bhart is an epithet of Vishnu, the preserver god, who holds the earth on his back. This name is considered auspicious and bestowed upon a child with the hope that they will grow up to be strong, steadfast, and supportive.
